meta_description:
181K likes, 14K comments - shenaztreasury on September 15, 2026: "Let’s start a terrace forest movement in India! 🌳🇮🇳 Sir Venkat has done the unimaginable and can do this in your home too. 

Imagine if every empty rooftop in our cities became a little urban forest.

This man is an engineering genius, and turning terraces into green spaces is his passion. He can actually guide people on how to do it.

We have SO many cool, intelligent people in India doing unique things for sustainability, urban greening and the environment. We just need to know about them — and amplify them.

Stories like this make me love my India. 🇮🇳

Share this with someone who has a terrace. Let’s make our cities greener, one rooftop at a time.

Terrace forest India | rooftop garden | urban forest | sustainable living India | terrace gardening | urban greening | climate solutions | green cities | rooftop forest | Indian innovation".
